Title: Memory management in 40 major C projects, a survey - The Consensus
Description: A survey of 40 major C projects tracked by The Consensus shows only 8 projects allocate solely with malloc/free, only 2 projects allocate without ever using malloc/free, 15 projects make use of regions at some point, 7 projects primarily use regions to allocate, 5 primarily use garbage collection to allocate, and 3 primarily use reference counting to allocate.

Title: Qwen

QWEN STUDIO DISCORD
Today, we are introducing Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery. Qwen4-Max is built on the new Qwen4 architecture, with a 2.4-trillion-parameter backbone, native vision capabilities, and a one-million-token context window.

Title: A datetime library for Rust
Description:
Jiff is a datetime library for Rust that encourages you to jump into the
pit of success. Jiff automatically handles many common problems related to
daylight saving time by putting time zone handling front and center into the
API. Jiff has already seen widespread adoption in the Rust ecosystem.

Title: Someone's impersonating this blog — A Lovely Harmless Monster – Blog
Description: I was googling the name of my website, as one does occasionally, and was surprised to see a link to one of my blog posts on mataroa.site. At first I figured it was just an alternate domain name for mataroa.blog, but no, when you type mataroa.site into your browser, it shows you my blog. It's the only thing that's hosted there.

Title: We’re Asking an Appeals Court to Require a Warrant for ALPR Searches
Description: Automated license plate readers are simply not comparable to observing an individual license plate on a passing car. As we’ve explained in many amicus briefs and in our lawsuits directly challenging their use, ALPRs give law enforcement “a virtual time machine to view suspects’, or anyone else’s, past movements (and much more) with just the click of a button.”
